pinterest.title: How to organize the family room craft area
pinterest.description: Hold craft supplies grouped by activity so a project can start in one motion and the surface can be cleared for dinner just as fast. Done looks like: Labeled bins (paper and card, drawing, glue and tape, kits in progress); Scissors standing point down in a cup out of the youngest child's reach. Free step-by-step for this zone: https://6s-success.com/zones/family-room-the-craft-and-activity-zone.html

instagram.caption:
The half-finished project.
The Craft and Activity Zone in the Family Room. Hold craft supplies grouped by activity so a project can start in one motion and the surface can be cleared for dinner just as fast.

What done looks like:
1. Labeled bins (paper and card, drawing, glue and tape, kits in progress)
2. Scissors standing point down in a cup out of the youngest child's reach
3. One completely clear work surface
4. Exactly one project bin out on it

Free written steps for this zone, no signup: link in bio, or search 6S Success craft and activity zone.
